Huawei Highlights AI-Powered Innovation, Next-Generation Connectivity and Strategic Partnerships at MWC26 Doha
summary:
Huawei concluded its participation as Headline Sponsor of MWC Doha 2026, held from November 8–10 at the Doha Exhibition and Convention Centre (DECC), reinforcing its commitment to advancing artificial intelligence (AI), next-generation connectivity and resilient digital infrastructure in Qatar and the wider region.
Under the theme "Advancing All Intelligence and Resilience,” Huawei showcased its latest innovations in intelligent connectivity, industry-specific AI applications and cloud infrastructure, while contributing to high-level industry discussions and strengthening strategic partnerships to accelerate Qatar's digital transformation.
A key highlight of Huawei's participation was the keynote address, "The Infrastructure of Intelligence,” delivered by Mr. Liu Kang, President of ICT Marketing and Solution Sales at Huawei. Liu highlighted how the rapid evolution of AI is reshaping digital infrastructure requirements and creating new growth opportunities for telecos operators. He emphasized that computing power determines the depth of intelligence, while connectivity defines its reach, underscoring the essential role of next-generation networks in unlocking AI's full potential and enabling intelligent services at scale.
Huawei also reinforced its contribution to Qatar's next-generation connectivity ambitions as the technology partner in the Communications Regulatory Authority's (CRA) advanced technology trials, conducted in collaboration with Ooredoo Qatar and Vodafone Qatar. Showcased at the State of Qatar Pavilion, the trials demonstrated significant advancements in mobile network speed, capacity and performance, by ultilizing the state-of-art 256T256R RetinaMIMO U6GHz VitaAAU, representing an important step toward the 6G era. Building on CRA's Qatar 6G Testbed Platform initiative, the collaboration highlights the importance of industry partnerships in accelerating innovation and advancing Qatar's digital ambitions.

Mr. Lin Jincan, President, GCC Region, Huawei
"Qatar has a clear ambition for its digital future, and Huawei is committed to contributing to this journey,” said Mr. Lin Jincan, President, GCC Region, Huawei. "At MWC Doha 2026, we demonstrated how the latest advances in AI and connectivity can translate into more efficient operations and resilient digital infrastructure for people, businesses, and industries. Through continued collaboration with our customers and partners, we aim to bring global innovation and expertise closer to Qatar's evolving digital needs and support the country's transition towards a knowledge-based, innovation-driven economy, in line with Qatar National Vision 2030.”
During the 3 days of MWC26 Doha, Huawei contributed to major industry discussions through the Smart Mobility Summit, and the Future Networks Summit, where Huawei's experts shared perspectives on the future of intelligent mobility, connected ecosystems, network evolution and the journey toward 6G.
Further strengthening its collaboration with Qatar's technology ecosystem, Huawei signed two strategic Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) during the event. The agreement with Fadaat Media aims to power Mourakeb with advanced cloud infrastructure, while the agreement with Qshield reinforces a 12-year strategic partnership. Together, these collaborations reflect Huawei's commitment to fostering innovation and supporting long-term digital development in Qatar.
Throughout the event, Huawei also demonstrated how its Connectivity and AItoX portfolios, alongside Huawei Cloud capabilities, can support telecommunications operators, enterprises and government entities in enhancing digital experiences, improving operational efficiency and accelerating AI adoption across industries.
Huawei's participation at MWC Doha 2026 reaffirmed its commitment to working closely with customers, partners and industry stakeholders to advance Qatar National Vision 2030 and Digital Agenda 2030, supporting the development of a more connected, intelligent and resilient digital economy.

content: Huawei concluded its participation as Headline Sponsor at MWC26 Doha, highlighting artificial intelligence, next-generation connectivity, and strategic partnerships. Under the theme 'Advancing All Intelligence and Resilience,' the company showcased advanced cloud infrastructure and intelligent solutions. Executives emphasized the critical role of computing power and connectivity in shaping digital infrastructure, supporting Qatar's national vision and digital transformation goals through key collaborations and advanced technology trials.
content_ta: MWC26 Doha மாநாட்டில் Headline Sponsor-ஆக கலந்துகொண்ட Huawei நிறுவனம், AI, அடுத்த தலைமுறை இணைப்பு மற்றும் மூலோபாய கூட்டாண்மைகளை முன்னிலைப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. 'Advancing All Intelligence and Resilience' என்ற கருப்பொருளின் கீழ், நிறுவனம் மேம்பட்ட cloud infrastructure மற்றும் intelligent solutions-ஐ காட்சிப்படுத்தியது. Qatar-ன் digital transformation இலக்குகளை ஆதரிக்கும் வகையில் பல்வேறு முக்கிய கூட்டாண்மைகளில் இந்நிறுவனம் கையெழுத்திட்டுள்ளது.
